mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, device_id, measure_time, heart_rate, duration_seconds, waveform FROM t_ecg_record WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ecg_record (user_id, device_id, measure_time, heart_rate, duration_seconds, waveform) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{measureTime}, #{heartRate}, #{durationSeconds}, #{waveform})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ecg_record SET user_id=#{userId}, device_id=#{deviceId}, measure_time=#{measureTime}, heart_rate=#{heartRate}, duration_seconds=#{durationSeconds}, waveform=#{waveform} WHERE id=#{id}
